name: Ladies' Luck: The Heart of the Sky
source:
An over-the-hill career criminal is dragged into the underworld to babysit three up-and-coming thieves for one last score—the precious Heart of the Sky diamond.

[From [url=https://moyangi.itch.io/ladies-luck-the-heart-of-the-sky]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一名早已过气的职业老贼被迫重出江湖，只为带带三名初出茅庐的后辈飞贼，干完职业生涯的最后一票——盗取价值连城的“苍穹之心”钻石。

[摘自[url=https://moyangi.itch.io/ladies-luck-the-heart-of-the-sky]itch.io[/url]]
